get.summary: List capabilities and whether each is enabled
get.description: List the public capabilities visible to the API key's organization with an `enabled` flag for each. Call this before planning multi-capability work: every generally available capability appears whether or not it is enabled, so clients can distinguish a capability that exists but is disabled from one that does not exist. Use `key` values when interpreting usage rollups and capability-specific workflows.

post.description: Generate finished sales-collateral files — proposals, playbooks, decks, GTM strategies, reports or one-pagers as `.pptx`/`.docx`/`.pdf` — from a `brief`, driven by the Doc Maker managed agent. The platform composes the selling context from your Brand Pack (the organization's default brand unless `brand` selects another profile; the brand must have a completed guideline or the request fails with `409 brand_guideline_missing`) plus the optional `offer`, and the agent follows up to three reference `template_urls`. Poll `GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}` until the job reaches a terminal state, then download each referenced file with `GET /v1/documents/{job_id}/files/{file_id}`. Send `Idempotency-Key` so an ambiguous request can safely replay its original response for 24 hours.

post.description: Run a bounded, robots-respecting crawl of the target website's own HTTPS origin (up to `max_pages` pages) and distill the pages into one typed site-intelligence report: company profile, products, pricing, customers, technology, team, content, and positioning — every section grounded in crawled source URLs. Poll `GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}` until the job reaches a terminal state. Send `Idempotency-Key` so an ambiguous retry replays the original response for 24 hours.

sections.title: Sections
sections.description: Optional subset of sections to generate. Omit to generate the complete playbook.

model.title: Model
model.description: Generation model selection. `default` is the currently supported model.

intelligence.title: Intelligence
intelligence.description: Optional model tier for the generation agents: `low`, `medium`, `high`, or `ultra`. Defaults from the selected playbook template, else `high`.

brand_profile_id.title: Brand Profile Id
brand_profile_id.description: Optional organization brand-profile identifier. It must belong to the API key's organization.

brand_profile_key.title: Brand Profile Key
brand_profile_key.description: Optional stable brand-profile key. It must agree with `brand_profile_id` when both are supplied.

stage.title: Stage
stage.description: Optional deal stage the playbook targets. Any short lowercase slug is accepted — organizations define their own stage vocabulary on their playbook templates; `GET /v1/playbook-templates` lists the catalog's suggested stages alongside org-defined ones. Defaults from `playbook_template_key` when omitted.

playbook_template_key.title: Playbook Template Key
playbook_template_key.description: Optional playbook template key from `GET /v1/playbook-templates` — an organization-defined template (fixing offer, brand, stage and sales approach) or a curated catalog entry. Unknown keys fail the request with `playbook_template_not_found`. A catalog key must agree with `stage` when both are supplied.

offer_id.title: Offer Id
offer_id.description: Optional offer to sell with; its value propositions and proof points are embedded as generation context.

campaign_id.title: Campaign Id
campaign_id.description: Optional campaign frame for the playbook. The campaign's offer is inherited when `offer_id` is omitted.

PlaybookInput.title: PlaybookInput
PlaybookInput.description:
Stable public input shape for Playbooks.

The backend still calls this value `target_company_domain`; the platform keeps the
public API broader so a caller can provide either a name or a domain.
